text: {"name":"configure_stream_segment","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Configures the current stream entry and its descriptor links, then either invokes continuation handling when the accumulated extent exceeds the limit or advances to the next entry.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"a2":"entry_cursor","a3":"capacity_limit","a4":"requested_size","a5":"stream_index","v5":"current_stream_entry","v6":"stream_context","v12":"stream_descriptor","v13":"aligned_size","v14":"additional_word_count","v15":"length_increment","v16":"accumulated_length","v17":"current_control_flags","v18":"configured_control_flags","v22":"stream_descriptor","v23":"new_total_extent"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":10,"meaning":"Stream context's 16-bit accumulated count, increased by the entry's length increment."},{"offset":24,"meaning":"Stream context's current descriptor link, replaced with a pointer into the new descriptor."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Control/status flags populated with stream mode bits and the additional-word count."},{"offset":40,"meaning":"Stream context's accumulated extent."},{"offset":68,"meaning":"Pointer to the associated stream context."},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Pointer to the stream descriptor used to calculate the aligned size."},{"offset":80,"meaning":"16-bit length increment added to the stream context's accumulated count."},{"offset":268,"meaning":"Stream context pointer to the configured entry."},{"offset":324,"meaning":"Stream context pointer used to advance to the next chained entry."}]}
